about: Hassan has served as a President, CGO, GM and BD Director for global & local brands within worldwide leading Fortune 500 and CAC-40 companies in the industries of FMCG, Consumer Care, Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices. His strength is to assess the business and market landscape, then align resources, people, and product delivery to accelerate revenue.

Neo Essentials Trading was founded by a group of friends with diverse nationalities, backgrounds and business expertise who were eager to start up a business that would oversee the distribution of their favorite products in Middle Eastern and African select markets.
